sandbox.ui.title: UI
sandbox.ui.alertDescription: A persistent application alert above the page. A new alert replaces the previous alert without clearing snackbars.
sandbox.ui.snackbarDescription: Messages appear one at a time without moving the page. Queue several messages while a page alert remains visible.
sandbox.ui.message.error: The operation could not be completed.
sandbox.ui.timedMessage: This page alert disappears after five seconds.
sandbox.ui.persistentMessage: This snackbar stays until you close it.
sandbox.ui.loadingDescription: Shows the global overlay and app-bar progress line for two seconds, then automatically releases loading.
